example_sentences_in_bangla: এই পুরনো জিনিসপত্র কাড়াকড়ির মতো মূল্যহীন।
তার কথা কাড়াকড়ি বলে কেউ গুরুত্ব দেয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: These old things are as worthless as broken cowries.
No one pays attention to his words; they're like worthless trinkets.
history: কড়ি (cowrie shells) was a traditional form of currency in ancient Bengal and rural economies, and defective ones symbolized utter worthlessness.
note: The idiom draws from historical trade practices where cowries were used as small denomination money.
